# Security Checklist: Base de telas (screen-base)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de segurança da 003 (leitura só por propriedade dentro do jogo, leitura
do código do jogo instalado sem chamar nada, apagar o `names.json` e os irmãos, nada do jogo nem nome de jogador no
repositório) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Leitura dentro do jogo

- [x] CHK001 Is property-only reading stated for every new field, excluding calls to game functions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK002 Is the read-only test required to cover the new fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are writing to the save and automating clicks explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK004 Is an absent behavior defined as not being an error, so the reading just continues? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]

## Código do jogo instalado

- [x] CHK005 Is the verification limited to reading the installed file, with nothing called inside the game? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated that the game file is only read as text, never executed by the app, and that names taken from it are shown as plain text? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Is a game file that is missing, unreadable or in a new format handled without breaking the app or inventing a name? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Does the verification leave unchanged what the update watch already does to protect the player? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK009 Is network access excluded outside the app's updater, so reading the tables and the verification stay local? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Apagar arquivos do usuário

- [x] CHK010 Is the deletion limited to three named files in a named folder? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK011 Is the moment of the deletion specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK012 Is deleting without a copy an explicit, documented decision? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012, §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK013 Is the behavior specified when the files cannot be deleted? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Repositório e dados

- [x] CHK014 Is the game file excluded from the repository and from the installer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK015 Is it stated that the example game code used by the tests is made up, with no excerpt of the real file? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §US5, §US6]
- [x] CHK016 Are player names excluded from the test data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK017 Is what the keeper writes to `keeper.log` limited to screen numbers, with nothing shown to the player? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK006, CHK013 e CHK015: respondidos por padrões do agente (Open Questions).
